ImageDescription.value: The Fairmont Le Château Frontenac, formerly and commonly referred to as the Château Frontenac, is a historic hotel located in Quebec City, Quebec, Canada. The Château Frontenac was completed in 1893, and was designed by American architect Bruce Price. The hotel was a part of a series of Chateauesque-styled hotels built for the Canadian Pacific Railway company during the late 19th and early 20th centuries.

128737.title: File:Satellite image of New Zealand in December 2002.jpg

ImageDescription.value:
Satellite image of New Zealand in December 2002. NASA's description:
<dl><dd>These stunning true-color images provide a rare, cloud-free look at the island nation of New Zealand, including most of its North and South Islands. This scene was acquired by the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS), flying aboard NASA’s Terra satellite, on October 23, and December 31, 2002. New Zealand is situated in the South Pacific Ocean, roughly 2,000 km (1,250 miles) southeast of Australia. Wellington, the capital of New Zealand, is located on the southern tip of the North Island, looking across Cook Strait toward South Island.</dd></dl>

Artist.value: Jacques Descloitres, MODIS Land Rapid Response Team at NASA GSFC
